findings.observed: All four manifest hashes differ from the checked-in seed bytes: TARGET_CHARTER.md declares 5aea61dec6babcc2dd09abecc41349139f1e5fc01c2ec6f10df9af18beeb8a78 but is 43a43f2f6a494e1b5e9b2eb118e6a43765304d2630d379e607e56d4e725a3a63; the validator rejects at the first mismatch before broker construction.
findings.expected: The sealed five-file target seed validates against its manifest so AcceptanceBroker can materialize a fresh disposable target repository.
findings.reproduction: At commit 62ff09624b06e418c1f767e0985e019c776e46ce run: python -c "from pathlib import Path; from firmware_acceptance.kit import validate_seed_manifest; validate_seed_manifest(Path('firmware_acceptance/seed'))". It raises AdmissionError: seed hash mismatch: TARGET_CHARTER.md. Hashing each manifest entry shows all four declared hashes are stale.
findings.impact: The public acceptance-kit constructor rejects the shipped target seed, blocking target materialization and every dependent S2/C3 acceptance flow.
findings.no_fix_consequence: The acceptance campaign cannot begin normally; C43, C49, C63, and C65 remain unprovable regardless of MCP or host correctness.
findings.smallest_fix: Update the four TARGET_SEED_MANIFEST.json hashes to the accepted sealed-file bytes, or restore the four files to the exact bytes named by the manifest, then rerun affected seed and broker tests.
findings.complexity: A four-value manifest correction or restoration of the intended sealed bytes, plus focused validation.
findings.regression_risk: Low and bounded: validate_seed_manifest immediately verifies the exact chosen seed identity.
findings.verification_cost: Run the affected seed/broker test modules after the correction; no hardware or MCP process is required.
findings.alternatives: Bypassing or weakening the validator would violate the exact hash-bound seed contract and creates higher provenance risk.
findings.cost_benefit: The small, deterministic identity correction restores the mandatory target-materialization entrypoint, while leaving it unresolved blocks the whole downstream campaign.
